$schema_note: Each palette must define bg, primary, accent, muted, text. Optional: safe, warn, danger, surface, surface_alt, border. Extended verdict slots (safe_bg, warn_bg, danger_bg) give a tinted card fill that pairs with the matching verdict stroke colour for room/card compositions. All values are hex strings.

ask-arthur._description: Ask Arthur brand palette — matches the askarthur.au site audit / scan results page (e.g. /scan/<token>). Deep navy primary, action teal accent, warm slate body text, neutral cool-grey card surfaces, and editorial verdict tones (forest green / burnt orange / oxblood red) for safe / warn / danger labels. Verdict-tinted surfaces (mint / cream / blush) live in the *_bg slots for status-coloured cards or 'rooms'. Sourced verbatim from apps/web/app/globals.css.

ask-arthur-dark._description: Inverted Ask Arthur palette for dark-mode diagrams or hero blog images on dark backgrounds.

neutral._description: Generic monochrome fallback when the diagram doesn't belong to a specific brand context (internal docs, scratch).

warm-editorial._description: Cream + deep navy + accent terracotta — matches the ask-arthur-warm-editorial illustration style for blog posts that already use those visuals.
